Lightning Talk: Reducing Binary Bloat With Thin Archives - Florent Castelli - CppCon 2025
---

Build folders of big projects are quite large. Did you know that a traditional build will have 2 copies of every object file in it?
Let's talk about thin archives and explain what they can do for your build to avoid the extra copy.
---

Work at Hudson River Trading (HRT): https://tinyurl.com/safxfctf

Florent Castelli

Florent is an engineer at EngFlow who has a lot of opinions on how to make builds faster and more manageable. He previously wrangled with build systems in video game studios, Spotify and Google.
